in_marathi.name: Laya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Laya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Laya means ‘dancer’ or ‘melody’. This name is derived from the root word ‘laya’ which means ‘to fold’. In Hindu mythology, Goddess Saraswati is often depicted as a dancer, representing the harmonious union of knowledge, music, and art. The name Laya is also associated with the concept of ‘laya’, the divine energy that permeates the universe and is the source of all creation.
